modeHints.ask: Reads files and Hub only. No terminal and no tools from other servers, so it cannot run tests or change anything.
modeHints.plan: Reads files and Hub only, and ends in a proposed plan for you to review. No terminal and no tools from other servers.
modeHints.execute: Claude reads and edits inside this folder freely. Delete, commit, push, deploy, branch, worktree and docker wait for your approval, as does any command you have not allowed.

failures.signed_out: Claude is signed out on this device. Run claude auth login there, then press Check again.
failures.rate_limited: The usage limit is reached. It clears at the time shown, and nothing retries by itself.
failures.billing: Claude reports a billing problem on this account.
failures.overloaded: Claude is overloaded right now. Try again in a moment.
failures.version_out_of_range: This device's Claude Code is older than the minimum Hub needs. Update it, or use Open in VS Code.
failures.claude_missing: Claude Code was not found on this device.
failures.session_missing: Claude no longer has this conversation. Send again to start over from here.
failures.folder_not_allowed: That folder is not registered on this project.
failures.folder_missing: That folder does not exist on the device.
failures.device_offline: The device went offline during this turn, so the turn stopped. Any approval it was waiting on did not run. Send again once the device is back.
failures.cut_off: Claude Code stopped before the turn ended.
failures.unknown: This turn failed, and Claude did not say why.
failures.unreadable_event: Claude Code sent something Hub cannot read, so this turn was stopped. Open in VS Code to carry on there.

approvals.title: Waiting for your approval
approvals.expires: Denied automatically if nobody answers by {time}

categories.hub_project: Changes the project, including its allowed folders
categories.other: A command you have not allowed

explain_card.label: Explain this
explain_card.prompt: Explain {key}: what it is, where it stands, and what it depends on.

plan_card.label: Plan this
plan_card.prompt: Make a plan for {key}, with steps and acceptance checks.

work_card.label: Do this task
work_card.runs: Runs /hub:work now in Execute: it may start the task, edit files and run commands. Delete, commit and push still pause for you.

decide_card.label: Help me decide
decide_card.prompt: Lay out the options on {key}, with what each one costs, so I can decide.

deliver_card.label: Deliver this
deliver_card.prompt: What does {key} need, and what is left before it can be delivered?

review_card.label: Review this
review_card.prompt: Run the acceptance checks of {key} and show the real output, then say whether it meets them.

apply_card.label: Apply this handoff
apply_card.prompt: Read the handoff {key} and apply it here.

redesign_card.label: Redesign this
redesign_card.prompt: Look at the redesign {key} and tell me what to change next.

improve_doc.label: Improve this doc
improve_doc.runs: Runs /hub:doc now in Execute: it searches, then shows a draft. Nothing is saved until you press Save.

document_card.label: Document this
document_card.runs: Runs /hub:doc now in Execute: it searches, then shows a draft. Nothing is saved until you press Save.

whats_next.label: What should I do next?
whats_next.prompt: What should I do next on this project, and why?

summarize_today.label: Sum up today
summarize_today.prompt: Sum up what is waiting on me today.

honest.offlineApproval: The device is offline, so this cannot be answered. Its turn stopped and nothing ran.
honest.newerVersion: Claude Code {version} is newer than the version Hub tested ({tested}). It runs and the permission rules stay active, but a change in its behaviour may show up here first.

starting.new: Starting Claude Code. This takes about 10 seconds.
starting.resume: Starting Claude Code again from this conversation. This takes about 10 seconds.
starting.mode: The mode changed, so Claude Code is restarting. This takes about 10 seconds.
starting.model: The model changed, so Claude Code is restarting. This takes about 10 seconds.
starting.effort: The effort changed, so Claude Code is restarting. This takes about 10 seconds.
starting.folder: The folder changed, so Claude Code is restarting. This takes about 10 seconds.

blocked.title: {mode} refused this
blocked.switchHint: Restarts Claude Code in Execute, where it can run this. Delete, commit, push and the like still pause for you.

report.title: Work report
report.dropped: Left out since the last report
report.refused: Report refused: a step it says passed really failed

filesFrom.claimed: Claude's words, with nothing from the device to back them

basis.matched: Agrees with the last real run
basis.outside_panel: Outside the panel, so there are no steps to check
basis.no_command: No command to match, so this is only Claude's word
basis.no_matching_step: No step ran this exact command
basis.step_mismatch: The named step ran something else
basis.outcome_differs: The last real run succeeded, and Claude reported otherwise

move.all_verified: Every check is verified, so the task moved to In review. You complete it.
move.no_checks: It stays where it is: the report has no checks.
move.check_not_passed: It stays where it is: not every check passed.
move.check_not_verified: It stays where it is: not every check matches a real step that succeeded.
move.check_dropped: It stays where it is: this report leaves out a check an earlier one named.
move.outside_panel: This chat is outside the panel, so the checks stay claimed and the task does not move.
move.not_a_task: It stays where it is: this card is not a task.
move.wrong_status: It stays where it is: only a started task moves to In review.
move.not_permitted: It stays where it is: your roles do not allow moving it.

plan.title: Proposed plan
plan.runHint: Puts the plan in the composer in Execute. Nothing runs until you send it.

question.title: Claude is asking
question.stopped: The turn stopped before this was answered.

draft.title: Proposed document
draft.answerFlags: Answer each flag before saving: {count} left

refusedCodes.hub.docs.stale_base: This document changed after the draft was written, so nothing was saved.
refusedCodes.hub.docs.draft_flags_open: A flag has no answer yet, so nothing was saved.

draft.saved: Saved. The earlier text is kept as a revision, and nothing is committed.
